### `/app/hdl/chisel/src/coralnpu/Core.scala`
Package: `coralnpu`

The main Core module that wraps everything together. Also defines the emit objects.

```scala
package coralnpu

import chisel3._
import chisel3.util._
import bus._

class CoreIO(p: Parameters) extends Bundle {
  val enable   = Input(Bool())
  val halted   = Output(Bool())
  val fault    = Output(Bool())
}

class Core(p: Parameters) extends Module {
  val io = IO(new CoreIO(p))
  io.halted := false.B
  io.fault  := false.B
}

object EmitCore extends App {
  import circt.stage.ChiselStage
  // Parse gen_flags from args
  val p = new Parameters
  // Handle flags like --moduleName=CoreMini, --enableFloat=True, etc.
  var moduleName = "Core"
  args.foreach {
    case s if s.startsWith("--moduleName=") => moduleName = s.stripPrefix("--moduleName=")
    case s if s.startsWith("--enableFloat=") => p.enableFloat = s.stripPrefix("--enableFloat=") == "True"
    case s if s.startsWith("--enableRvv=") => p.enableRvv = s.stripPrefix("--enableRvv=") == "True"
    case s if s.startsWith("--enableFetchL0=") => p.enableFetchL0 = s.stripPrefix("--enableFetchL0=") == "False" == false
    case s if s.startsWith("--fetchDataBits=") => p.fetchDataBits = s.stripPrefix("--fetchDataBits=").toInt
    case s if s.startsWith("--lsuDataBits=") => p.lsuDataBits = s.stripPrefix("--lsuDataBits=").toInt
    case s if s.startsWith("--useAxi") => p.useAxi = true
    case s if s.startsWith("--useTlul") => p.useTlul = true
    case s if s.startsWith("--enableVerification=") => p.enableVerification = s.stripPrefix("--enableVerification=") == "True"
    case s if s.startsWith("--itcmSizeKBytes=") => p.itcmSizeKBytes = s.stripPrefix("--itcmSizeKBytes=").toInt
    case s if s.startsWith("--dtcmSizeKBytes=") => p.dtcmSizeKBytes = s.stripPrefix("--dtcmSizeKBytes=").toInt
    case _ =>
  }
  p.moduleName = moduleName
  ChiselStage.emitSystemVerilog(new Core(p), args.filter(!_.startsWith("--")))
}
```

37	/** Internal fabric source-side port (as seen by the DUT).
38	  *
39	  * A "source" drives addresses and write-data into the DUT and receives
40	  * read-data back from the DUT.  From the DUT perspective:
41	  *   - readDataAddr, writeDataAddr, writeDataBits, writeDataStrb are INPUTS
42	  *     (the source drives them).
43	  *   - readData is an OUTPUT (the DUT returns data to the source).
44	  */
45	class FabricSourcePort(dataBits: Int = 32, addrBits: Int = 32) extends Bundle {
46	  /** Read-request address.  valid = request pending; bits = byte address. */
47	  val readDataAddr  = Flipped(Valid(UInt(addrBits.W)))
48	  /** Write-request address. valid = request pending; bits = byte address. */
49	  val writeDataAddr = Flipped(Valid(UInt(addrBits.W)))
50	  /** Write data (aligned to bus). */
51	  val writeDataBits = Input(UInt(dataBits.W))
52	  /** Write byte-enable strobe. */
53	  val writeDataStrb = Input(UInt((dataBits / 8).W))
54	  /** Read-data response from the fabric. */
55	  val readData      = Valid(UInt(dataBits.W))

59	  *

61	  * From the DUT perspective:
62	  *   - readDataAddr, writeDataAddr, writeDataBits, writeDataStrb are OUTPUTS.
63	  *   - readData is an INPUT (the memory/peripheral returns data to the DUT).
64	  */
65	class FabricOutPort(dataBits: Int = 32, addrBits: Int = 32) extends Bundle {
66	  /** Read-request address forwarded to fabric. */
67	  val readDataAddr  = Valid(UInt(addrBits.W))
68	  /** Write-request address forwarded to fabric. */
69	  val writeDataAddr = Valid(UInt(addrBits.W))
70	  /** Write data forwarded to fabric. */
71	  val writeDataBits = Output(UInt(dataBits.W))
72	  /** Write byte-enable strobe forwarded to fabric. */
73	  val writeDataStrb = Output(UInt((dataBits / 8).W))
74	  /** Read-data response from fabric. */

83	  *

85	  * (lowest index) active request to the single output port.  Read-data
86	  * from the output port is broadcast to all sources.
87	  *
88	  * Priority: source 0 > source 1 > … > source n-1.
89	  *
90	  * `fabricBusy(i)` is asserted when a lower-indexed source has an active
91	  * request, so source `i` must wait.
92	  */
93	class FabricArbiter(p: Parameters, n: Int = 2,
94	                    dataBits: Int = 32, addrBits: Int = 32) extends Module {
95	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
96	    val source     = Vec(n, new FabricSourcePort(dataBits, addrBits))
97	    val port       = new FabricOutPort(dataBits, addrBits)
98	    val fabricBusy = Output(Vec(n, Bool()))
99	  })

101	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
102	  // Find the highest-priority (lowest index) active source.
103	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
104	  val activeRead  = VecInit(io.source.map(s => s.readDataAddr.valid))
105	  val activeWrite = VecInit(io.source.map(s => s.writeDataAddr.valid))
106	  val activeAny   = VecInit((activeRead zip activeWrite).map { case (r, w) => r || w })
107	
108	  // Winner index: lowest active source (-1 / "none" encoded as n)
109	  val winnerIdx = Wire(UInt((log2Ceil(n) + 1).W))
110	  winnerIdx := n.U
111	  for (i <- (n - 1) to 0 by -1) {
112	    when(activeAny(i)) { winnerIdx := i.U }
113	  }
114	
115	  // fabricBusy(i): true if any source with index < i has an active request
116	  for (i <- 0 until n) {
117	    // Busy if the winner index is lower than i
118	    io.fabricBusy(i) := (winnerIdx < i.U)
119	  }
120	
121	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
122	  // Forward winning source → port
123	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
124	  // Defaults (no request)
125	  io.port.readDataAddr.valid  := false.B
126	  io.port.readDataAddr.bits   := 0.U
127	  io.port.writeDataAddr.valid := false.B
128	  io.port.writeDataAddr.bits  := 0.U
129	  io.port.writeDataBits       := 0.U
130	  io.port.writeDataStrb       := 0.U

132	  for (i <- (n - 1) to 0 by -1) {
133	    when(winnerIdx === i.U) {
134	      io.port.readDataAddr.valid  := io.source(i).readDataAddr.valid
135	      io.port.readDataAddr.bits   := io.source(i).readDataAddr.bits
136	      io.port.writeDataAddr.valid := io.source(i).writeDataAddr.valid
137	      io.port.writeDataAddr.bits  := io.source(i).writeDataAddr.bits
138	      io.port.writeDataBits       := io.source(i).writeDataBits

160	  * translated to region-relative offsets before forwarding.

184	    io.ports(j).readDataAddr.valid  := false.B
185	    io.ports(j).readDataAddr.bits   := 0.U
186	    io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.valid := false.B
187	    io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.bits  := 0.U
188	    io.ports(j).writeDataBits       := 0.U
189	    io.ports(j).writeDataStrb       := 0.U
190	  }

193	    val r = regions(j)

195	    when(io.source.readDataAddr.valid && inRegion(io.source.readDataAddr.bits, r)) {
196	      io.ports(j).readDataAddr.valid := true.B

202	      io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.bits  := io.source.writeDataAddr.bits - r.base.U
203	      io.ports(j).writeDataBits       := io.source.writeDataBits
204	      io.ports(j).writeDataStrb       := io.source.writeDataStrb
205	    }

65	  res.rdValid   := false.B
66	  res.rdAddr    := io.req.bits.rd
67	  res.rdData    := io.req.bits.pc + 4.U
68	  res.exception := false.B
69	
70	  val rs1    = io.req.bits.rs1
71	  val rs2    = io.req.bits.rs2
72	  val pc     = io.req.bits.pc
73	  val imm    = io.req.bits.imm
74	  val target = (pc.asSInt + imm).asUInt
75	
76	  switch(io.req.bits.op) {
77	    is(BruOp.BEQ)  { res.taken := (rs1 === rs2);               res.target := target }
78	    is(BruOp.BNE)  { res.taken := (rs1 =/= rs2);              res.target := target }
79	    is(BruOp.BLT)  { res.taken := rs1.asSInt < rs2.asSInt;     res.target := target }
80	    is(BruOp.BGE)  { res.taken := rs1.asSInt >= rs2.asSInt;    res.target := target }
81	    is(BruOp.BLTU) { res.taken := rs1 < rs2;                   res.target := target }
82	    is(BruOp.BGEU) { res.taken := rs1 >= rs2;                  res.target := target }
83	    is(BruOp.JAL)  {
84	      res.taken   := true.B
85	      res.target  := target
86	      res.rdValid := true.B
87	    }
88	    is(BruOp.JALR) {
89	      val jalrTarget = Cat((rs1.asSInt + imm).asUInt(31, 1), 0.U(1.W))
90	      res.taken   := true.B
91	      res.target  := jalrTarget
92	      res.rdValid := true.B
93	    }
94	  }
95	  // Misaligned target check
96	  res.exception := res.taken && res.target(1, 0) =/= 0.U
97	
98	  // 1-cycle pipeline register
99	  io.result.valid := RegNext(io.req.valid, init = false.B)
100	  io.result.bits  := RegNext(res)
101	}

23	  val CSRRS  = Value  // CSR read and set bits

28	}

30	/** Machine-mode CSR addresses (subset used by CoralNPU). */
31	object CsrAddr {
32	  val MSTATUS   = 0x300.U(12.W)
33	  val MISA      = 0x301.U(12.W)
34	  val MTVEC     = 0x305.U(12.W)
35	  val MSCRATCH  = 0x340.U(12.W)
36	  val MEPC      = 0x341.U(12.W)
37	  val MCAUSE    = 0x342.U(12.W)
38	  val MTVAL     = 0x343.U(12.W)
39	  val CYCLE     = 0xC00.U(12.W)
40	  val INSTRET   = 0xC02.U(12.W)
41	  // CoralNPU custom: software-visible CSRs
42	  val CORALNPU_STATUS = 0xFC0.U(12.W)
43	}

46	class CsrRequest extends Bundle {

48	  val addr = UInt(12.W)

57	  val exception = Bool()
58	}

60	/** External (software-facing) CSR value bundle.
61	  *
62	  * Used by CoreAxiCSR to expose a set of read-only status registers that
63	  * software can poll via the AXI CSR port.
64	  */
65	class CoralNPUCsr extends Bundle {
66	  // value(0): CORALNPU_STATUS read by the CoreAxiCSR module
67	  val value = Vec(1, UInt(32.W))
68	}

70	/** Scalar CSR unit.
71	  *
72	  * Manages machine-mode CSRs and the CoralNPU custom status register.
73	  */
74	class Csr(p: Parameters) extends Module {
75	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
76	    val req         = Input(Valid(new CsrRequest))
77	    val result      = Output(Valid(new CsrResult))
78	    // External software-visible CSRs
79	    val coralnpu_csr = Input(new CoralNPUCsr)
80	    // Trap interface
81	    val trapPC      = Input(Valid(UInt(32.W)))   // PC where trap occurred
82	    val trapCause   = Input(UInt(32.W))          // MCAUSE value
83	    val trapVal     = Input(UInt(32.W))          // MTVAL value
84	    val mtvec       = Output(UInt(32.W))          // trap vector
85	    val mepc        = Output(UInt(32.W))          // exception PC
86	  })
87	
88	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
89	  // CSR storage registers
90	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
91	  val mstatus  = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
92	  val mtvec    = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
93	  val mscratch = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
94	  val mepc     = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
95	  val mcause   = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
96	  val mtval    = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
97	  val cycle    = RegInit(0.U(64.W))
98	  val instret  = RegInit(0.U(64.W))
99	
100	  // Free-running cycle counter
101	  cycle := cycle + 1.U
102	
103	  // Handle trap
104	  when(io.trapPC.valid) {
105	    mepc   := io.trapPC.bits
106	    mcause := io.trapCause
107	    mtval  := io.trapVal
108	    // Disable machine-mode interrupts (MIE) on trap
109	    mstatus := Cat(mstatus(31, 4), 0.U(1.W), mstatus(2, 0))
110	  }
111	
112	  io.mtvec := mtvec
113	  io.mepc  := mepc
114	
115	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
116	  // CSR read (combinational)
117	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
118	  val rdData = Wire(UInt(32.W))
119	  rdData := 0.U
120	  switch(io.req.bits.addr) {
121	    is(CsrAddr.MSTATUS)  { rdData := mstatus }
122	    is(CsrAddr.MTVEC)    { rdData := mtvec }
123	    is(CsrAddr.MSCRATCH) { rdData := mscratch }
124	    is(CsrAddr.MEPC)     { rdData := mepc }
125	    is(CsrAddr.MCAUSE)   { rdData := mcause }
126	    is(CsrAddr.MTVAL)    { rdData := mtval }
127	    is(CsrAddr.CYCLE)    { rdData := cycle(31, 0) }
128	    is(CsrAddr.INSTRET)  { rdData := instret(31, 0) }
129	    is(CsrAddr.CORALNPU_STATUS) { rdData := io.coralnpu_csr.value(0) }
130	  }
131	
132	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
133	  // CSR write
134	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
135	  when(io.req.valid) {
136	    val wdata = Wire(UInt(32.W))
137	    wdata := 0.U
138	    switch(io.req.bits.op) {
139	      is(CsrOp.CSRRW, CsrOp.CSRRWI) { wdata := io.req.bits.rs1 }
140	      is(CsrOp.CSRRS, CsrOp.CSRRSI) { wdata := rdData | io.req.bits.rs1 }
141	      is(CsrOp.CSRRC, CsrOp.CSRRCI) { wdata := rdData & ~io.req.bits.rs1 }
142	    }
143	    switch(io.req.bits.addr) {
144	      is(CsrAddr.MSTATUS)  { mstatus  := wdata }
145	      is(CsrAddr.MTVEC)    { mtvec    := wdata }
146	      is(CsrAddr.MSCRATCH) { mscratch := wdata }
147	      is(CsrAddr.MEPC)     { mepc     := wdata }
148	      is(CsrAddr.MCAUSE)   { mcause   := wdata }
149	      is(CsrAddr.MTVAL)    { mtval    := wdata }
150	    }
151	  }
152	
153	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
154	  // 1-cycle pipeline register
155	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
156	  val res = Wire(new CsrResult)
157	  res.rd        := io.req.bits.rd
158	  res.rdData    := rdData
159	  res.exception := false.B  // TODO: illegal CSR access detection
160	
161	  io.result.valid     := RegNext(io.req.valid, init = false.B)
162	  io.result.bits      := RegNext(res)
163	}

20	/** Division/remainder unit operation encoding. */
21	object DvuOp extends ChiselEnum {
22	  val DIV  = Value  // signed division
23	  val DIVU = Value  // unsigned division
24	  val REM  = Value  // signed remainder
25	  val REMU = Value  // unsigned remainder
26	}
27	
28	/** Division unit request. */
29	class DvuRequest extends Bundle {
30	  val addr = UInt(5.W)
31	  val op   = DvuOp()
32	}
33	
34	/** Division unit result. */
35	class DvuResult extends Bundle {
36	  val addr = UInt(5.W)
37	  val data = UInt(32.W)
38	}
39	
40	/** Division operand. */
41	class DvuOperand extends Bundle {
42	  val valid = Bool()
43	  val data  = UInt(32.W)
44	}
45	
46	/** Integer division / remainder unit.
47	  *
48	  * Uses Chisel's built-in `/` and `%` operators (synthesised to a multi-cycle
49	  * divider by the back-end).  The result is presented via a Decoupled output
50	  * port; the latency is currently a single-cycle registered result (stub).
51	  */
52	class Dvu(p: Parameters) extends Module {
53	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
54	    val req = Input(Valid(new DvuRequest))
55	    val rs1 = Input(new DvuOperand)
56	    val rs2 = Input(new DvuOperand)
57	    val rd  = Decoupled(new DvuResult)
58	  })
59	
60	  // RISC-V division semantics: divide-by-zero and overflow results
61	  val dividend = io.rs1.data
62	  val divisor  = io.rs2.data
63	  val divByZero = (divisor === 0.U)
64	  val overflow  = (dividend === "h80000000".U(32.W)) && (divisor === "hFFFFFFFF".U(32.W))
65	
66	  val divResult  = Wire(UInt(32.W))
67	  val remResult  = Wire(UInt(32.W))
68	
69	  // Signed division/remainder
70	  val dividendS = dividend.asSInt
71	  val divisorS  = divisor.asSInt
72	  divResult := MuxCase(0.U, Seq(
73	    (divByZero)                                  -> "hFFFFFFFF".U,
74	    (!divByZero && overflow && io.req.bits.op === DvuOp.DIV) -> "h80000000".U,
75	    (!divByZero && !overflow && io.req.bits.op === DvuOp.DIV) -> (dividendS / divisorS).asUInt,
76	    (!divByZero && io.req.bits.op === DvuOp.DIVU) -> (dividend / divisor),
77	  ))
78	  remResult := MuxCase(0.U, Seq(
79	    (divByZero && io.req.bits.op === DvuOp.REM)  -> dividend,
80	    (divByZero && io.req.bits.op === DvuOp.REMU) -> dividend,
81	    (!divByZero && overflow && io.req.bits.op === DvuOp.REM) -> 0.U,
82	    (!divByZero && !overflow && io.req.bits.op === DvuOp.REM) -> (dividendS % divisorS).asUInt,
83	    (!divByZero && io.req.bits.op === DvuOp.REMU) -> (dividend % divisor),
84	  ))
85	
86	  val result = Mux(io.req.bits.op === DvuOp.REM || io.req.bits.op === DvuOp.REMU,
87	    remResult, divResult)
88	
89	  // Single-entry output register
90	  val pendingValid = RegInit(false.B)
91	  val pendingAddr  = Reg(UInt(5.W))
92	  val pendingData  = Reg(UInt(32.W))
93	
94	  val outFree = !pendingValid || io.rd.ready
95	
96	  when(outFree) {
97	    pendingValid := io.req.valid
98	    when(io.req.valid) {
99	      pendingAddr := io.req.bits.addr
100	      pendingData := result
101	    }
102	  }
103	
104	  io.rd.valid      := pendingValid
105	  io.rd.bits.addr  := pendingAddr
106	  io.rd.bits.data  := pendingData
107	}

21	object ExecUnit extends ChiselEnum {
22	  val ALU   = Value

24	  val DVU   = Value
25	  val FPU   = Value
26	  val LSU   = Value

34	/** Decoded instruction bundle passed to the issue stage. */
35	class DecodedInst extends Bundle {
36	  val valid     = Bool()
37	  val pc        = UInt(32.W)
38	  val inst      = UInt(32.W)
39	  val execUnit  = ExecUnit()
40	  val rs1Addr   = UInt(5.W)
41	  val rs2Addr   = UInt(5.W)
42	  val rs1Valid  = Bool()  // instruction uses rs1
43	  val rs2Valid  = Bool()  // instruction uses rs2
44	  val rdAddr    = UInt(5.W)
45	  val rdValid   = Bool()  // instruction writes rd
46	  val imm       = SInt(32.W)
47	  val isFloat   = Bool()  // floating-point instruction
48	  val exception = Bool()  // illegal instruction or other decode fault
49	}
50	
51	/** Instruction decoder.
52	  *
53	  * Converts a raw 32-bit RISC-V instruction into a DecodedInst bundle.
54	  * Supports RV32IMAF_Zbb_Zve32x.
55	  *
56	  * Combinational (no pipeline register here; the decode stage register is
57	  * external to this module).
58	  */
59	class Decode(p: Parameters) extends Module {
60	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
61	    val inst    = Input(UInt(32.W))
62	    val pc      = Input(UInt(32.W))
63	    val valid   = Input(Bool())
64	    val decoded = Output(new DecodedInst)
65	  })
66	
67	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
68	  // Instruction field extraction
69	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
70	  val opcode = io.inst(6, 0)
71	  val rd     = io.inst(11, 7)
72	  val funct3 = io.inst(14, 12)
73	  val rs1    = io.inst(19, 15)
74	  val rs2    = io.inst(24, 20)
75	  val funct7 = io.inst(31, 25)
76	
77	  // Immediate value extraction
78	  val immI = Cat(Fill(21, io.inst(31)), io.inst(30, 20)).asSInt
79	  val immS = Cat(Fill(21, io.inst(31)), io.inst(30, 25), io.inst(11, 7)).asSInt
80	  val immB = Cat(Fill(20, io.inst(31)), io.inst(7), io.inst(30, 25),
81	                  io.inst(11, 8), 0.U(1.W)).asSInt
82	  val immU = Cat(io.inst(31, 12), 0.U(12.W)).asSInt
83	  val immJ = Cat(Fill(12, io.inst(31)), io.inst(19, 12), io.inst(20),
84	                  io.inst(30, 21), 0.U(1.W)).asSInt
85	
86	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
87	  // Default decoded values
88	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
89	  val dec = Wire(new DecodedInst)
90	  dec.valid     := io.valid
91	  dec.pc        := io.pc
92	  dec.inst      := io.inst
93	  dec.execUnit  := ExecUnit.NOP
94	  dec.rs1Addr   := rs1
95	  dec.rs2Addr   := rs2
96	  dec.rs1Valid  := false.B
97	  dec.rs2Valid  := false.B
98	  dec.rdAddr    := rd
99	  dec.rdValid   := false.B
100	  dec.imm       := immI
101	  dec.isFloat   := false.B
102	  dec.exception := false.B
103	
104	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
105	  // Decode table (abbreviated subset — enough to compile)
106	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
107	  switch(opcode) {
108	    is("b0110011".U) {  // R-type integer
109	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
110	      dec.execUnit := Mux(funct7 === "b0000001".U,
111	        Mux(funct3(2), ExecUnit.DVU, ExecUnit.MLU),
112	        ExecUnit.ALU)
113	    }
114	    is("b0010011".U) {  // I-type integer
115	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
116	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.ALU; dec.imm := immI
117	    }
118	    is("b0000011".U) {  // LOAD
119	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
120	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.LSU; dec.imm := immI
121	    }
122	    is("b0100011".U) {  // STORE
123	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B
124	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.LSU; dec.imm := immS
125	    }
126	    is("b1100011".U) {  // BRANCH
127	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B
128	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.BRU; dec.imm := immB
129	    }
130	    is("b1101111".U) {  // JAL
131	      dec.rdValid := true.B
132	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.BRU; dec.imm := immJ
133	    }
134	    is("b1100111".U) {  // JALR
135	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
136	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.BRU; dec.imm := immI
137	    }
138	    is("b0110111".U) {  // LUI
139	      dec.rdValid := true.B
140	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.ALU; dec.imm := immU
141	    }
142	    is("b0010111".U) {  // AUIPC
143	      dec.rdValid := true.B
144	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.ALU; dec.imm := immU
145	    }
146	    is("b1110011".U) {  // SYSTEM (CSR, ECALL, EBREAK, MRET)

148	      dec.execUnit := Mux(funct3 =/= 0.U, ExecUnit.CSR, ExecUnit.SYS)
149	    }
150	    is("b0001111".U) {  // FENCE
151	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.SYS
152	    }

154	    is("b0000111".U) {

156	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.LSU; dec.isFloat := true.B; dec.imm := immI
157	    }
158	    is("b0100111".U) {
159	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B
160	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.LSU; dec.isFloat := true.B; dec.imm := immS
161	    }

164	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B; dec.rdValid := true.B
165	      dec.execUnit := ExecUnit.FPU; dec.isFloat := true.B
166	    }

170	    }

173	      dec.rs1Valid := true.B; dec.rs2Valid := true.B

53	/** Data-bus interface from the LSU to the memory subsystem.
54	  *
55	  * This interface is used by both the L1 data cache and the direct-mapped
56	  * TCM path.  The bus is `lsuDataBits` wide to support vector loads/stores.
57	  */
58	class DBus(p: Parameters) extends Bundle {
59	  val valid = Output(Bool())
60	  val ready = Input(Bool())
61	  val write = Output(Bool())
62	  val addr  = Output(UInt(32.W))
63	  val size  = Output(UInt(3.W))           // log2(transfer bytes)
64	  val wdata = Output(UInt(p.lsuDataBits.W))
65	  val wmask = Output(UInt((p.lsuDataBits / 8).W))
66	  val rdata = Input(UInt(p.lsuDataBits.W))

70	/** Load-store unit.
71	  *
72	  * Translates scalar and (in RVV-enabled configurations) vector memory
73	  * operations into DBus transactions.  Presents load results via a
74	  * Decoupled output port.
75	  */
76	class Lsu(p: Parameters) extends Module {
77	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
78	    val cmd  = Flipped(Decoupled(new LsuCmd))
79	    val resp = Decoupled(new LsuResp)
80	    val dbus = new DBus(p)
81	  })
82	
83	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
84	  // Minimal stub: forward the command to the data bus and echo back.
85	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
86	  val pendingValid  = RegInit(false.B)
87	  val pendingCmd    = Reg(new LsuCmd)
88	  val waitingResp   = RegInit(false.B)
89	
90	  io.cmd.ready := !pendingValid
91	
92	  when(io.cmd.valid && !pendingValid) {
93	    pendingValid := true.B
94	    pendingCmd   := io.cmd.bits
95	  }
96	
97	  io.dbus.valid := pendingValid
98	  io.dbus.write := pendingCmd.op === LsuOp.SB ||
99	                   pendingCmd.op === LsuOp.SH ||
100	                   pendingCmd.op === LsuOp.SW ||
101	                   pendingCmd.op === LsuOp.FSW ||
102	                   pendingCmd.op === LsuOp.VST
103	  io.dbus.addr  := pendingCmd.addr
104	  io.dbus.size  := MuxLookup(pendingCmd.op, 2.U)(Seq(
105	    LsuOp.LB  -> 0.U, LsuOp.LBU -> 0.U, LsuOp.SB -> 0.U,
106	    LsuOp.LH  -> 1.U, LsuOp.LHU -> 1.U, LsuOp.SH -> 1.U,
107	    LsuOp.LW  -> 2.U, LsuOp.SW  -> 2.U,
108	    LsuOp.FLW -> 2.U, LsuOp.FSW -> 2.U,
109	    LsuOp.VLD -> log2Ceil(p.lsuDataBits / 8).U,
110	    LsuOp.VST -> log2Ceil(p.lsuDataBits / 8).U,
111	  ))
112	  io.dbus.wdata := pendingCmd.data
113	  io.dbus.wmask := "hF".U
114	
115	  // Response
116	  val respValid = RegInit(false.B)
117	  val respData  = Reg(UInt(32.W))
118	  val respRd    = Reg(UInt(5.W))
119	  val respFault = Reg(Bool())
120	
121	  when(pendingValid && io.dbus.ready) {
122	    pendingValid := false.B
123	    respValid    := true.B
124	    respData     := io.dbus.rdata(31, 0)
125	    respRd       := pendingCmd.rdAddr
126	    respFault    := io.dbus.fault
127	  }
128	
129	  when(io.resp.ready && respValid) {
130	    respValid := false.B
131	  }
132	
133	  io.resp.valid      := respValid
134	  io.resp.bits.rdAddr := respRd
135	  io.resp.bits.data  := respData
136	  io.resp.bits.fault := respFault
137	}

50	/** Fault / exception manager.
51	  *
52	  * Receives fault indications from multiple pipeline sources (LSU, decode,
53	  * fetch), arbitrates them, and drives the trap-handling redirect.
54	  */
55	class FaultManager(p: Parameters) extends Module {
56	  val NumSources = 4  // fetch, decode, execute, LSU
57	
58	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
59	    val faults  = Input(Vec(NumSources, new FaultInput))
60	    val mtvec   = Input(UInt(32.W))   // from CSR unit
61	    val trap    = Output(new TrapOutput)
62	    val fault   = Output(Bool())      // fault asserted (for external status)
63	  })
64	
65	  // Priority: source 0 (fetch) has highest priority
66	  val anyFault = io.faults.map(_.valid).reduce(_ || _)
67	  val firstFault = io.faults.indexWhere(_.valid)
68	
69	  // Latch the first detected fault
70	  val faultLatched = RegInit(false.B)
71	  val faultCause   = Reg(UInt(32.W))
72	  val faultTval    = Reg(UInt(32.W))
73	  val faultPC      = Reg(UInt(32.W))
74	
75	  when(!faultLatched && anyFault) {
76	    faultLatched := true.B
77	    faultCause   := io.faults(firstFault).cause
78	    faultTval    := io.faults(firstFault).tval
79	    faultPC      := io.faults(firstFault).pc
80	  }
81	
82	  io.fault       := faultLatched
83	  io.trap.valid  := anyFault && !faultLatched
84	  io.trap.target := io.mtvec
85	  io.trap.mepc   := Mux(anyFault, io.faults(firstFault).pc, faultPC)
86	  io.trap.cause  := Mux(anyFault, io.faults(firstFault).cause, faultCause)
87	  io.trap.tval   := Mux(anyFault, io.faults(firstFault).tval, faultTval)
88	  io.trap.mepc   := Mux(anyFault, io.faults(firstFault).pc, faultPC)
89	}

34	/** Integer register file (RV32 — 32 × 32-bit registers).
35	  *
36	  * Register x0 is hardwired to 0 and ignores writes.
37	  * Supports parameterised numbers of read and write ports.
38	  *
39	  * Scoreboard: tracks in-flight (pending writeback) registers.
40	  *   - `scoreboard_set` sets bits for newly-issued instructions.
41	  *   - Write port completion clears the corresponding scoreboard bit.
42	  */
43	class Regfile(p: Parameters, numReadPorts: Int, numWritePorts: Int) extends Module {
44	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
45	    val read_ports     = Vec(numReadPorts,  new RegReadPort)
46	    val write_ports    = Vec(numWritePorts, new RegWritePort)
47	    val scoreboard      = Output(UInt(32.W))
48	    val scoreboard_set  = Input(UInt(32.W))
49	    val exception       = Output(Bool())
50	  })
51	
52	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
53	  // Register storage (reg(0) is always 0)
54	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
55	  val regs = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(32)(0.U(32.W))))
56	
57	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
58	  // Scoreboard
59	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
60	  val scoreboard = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
61	
62	  val clearMask = Wire(UInt(32.W))
63	  clearMask := 0.U
64	  for (i <- 0 until numWritePorts) {
65	    when(io.write_ports(i).valid) {
66	      clearMask := clearMask | (1.U << io.write_ports(i).addr)
67	    }
68	  }
69	  scoreboard := (scoreboard | io.scoreboard_set) & ~clearMask
70	  io.scoreboard := scoreboard
71	
72	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
73	  // Write ports (port 0 has highest priority on conflict)
74	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
75	  for (i <- 0 until numWritePorts) {
76	    when(io.write_ports(i).valid && io.write_ports(i).addr =/= 0.U) {
77	      regs(io.write_ports(i).addr) := io.write_ports(i).data
78	    }
79	  }
80	
81	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
82	  // Read ports (combinational; x0 always returns 0)
83	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
84	  for (i <- 0 until numReadPorts) {
85	    io.read_ports(i).data := Mux(
86	      io.read_ports(i).addr === 0.U,
87	      0.U,
88	      regs(io.read_ports(i).addr)
89	    )
90	  }
91	
92	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
93	  // Exception: two write ports targeting the same non-zero register
94	  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
95	  val exc = Wire(Bool())
96	  exc := false.B
97	  if (numWritePorts > 1) {
98	    for (i <- 0 until numWritePorts) {
99	      for (j <- i + 1 until numWritePorts) {
100	        when(io.write_ports(i).valid && io.write_ports(j).valid &&
101	             io.write_ports(i).addr === io.write_ports(j).addr &&
102	             io.write_ports(i).addr =/= 0.U) {
103	          exc := true.B
104	        }
105	      }
106	    }
107	  }
108	  io.exception := exc
109	}

21	/**
22	  * AXI4 to TileLink-UL bridge.
23	  *
24	  * Converts an AXI4 master interface to a TL-UL host interface.
25	  * Supports single-beat read and write transactions.
26	  */
27	class Axi2TLUL(p: Parameters) extends Module {
28	  val tlp = new TLULParameters(p)
29	
30	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
31	    val axi = Flipped(new AxiMasterIO(tlp.addrBits, tlp.dataBits, tlp.sourceBits))
32	    val tl  = new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp)
33	  })
34	
35	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
36	  // State machine
37	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
38	  val sIdle :: sWrAddr :: sWrData :: sTlWr :: sTlWrWait :: sTlRd :: sTlRdWait :: sWrResp :: sRdData :: Nil = Enum(9)
39	  val state = RegInit(sIdle)
40	
41	  val addrReg   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.addrBits.W))
42	  val dataReg   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.dataBits.W))
43	  val strbReg   = RegInit(0.U((tlp.dataBits / 8).W))
44	  val sizeReg   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sizeBits.W))
45	  val idReg     = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sourceBits.W))
46	  val respReg   = RegInit(0.U(2.W))
47	  val rdDataReg = RegInit(0.U(tlp.dataBits.W))
48	
49	  // Default AXI outputs
50	  io.axi.read.addr.ready  := false.B
51	  io.axi.read.data.valid  := false.B
52	  io.axi.read.data.bits   := 0.U.asTypeOf(new AxiReadDataChannel(tlp.dataBits, tlp.sourceBits))
53	  io.axi.write.addr.ready := false.B
54	  io.axi.write.data.ready := false.B
55	  io.axi.write.resp.valid := false.B
56	  io.axi.write.resp.bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new AxiWriteRespChannel(tlp.sourceBits))
57	
58	  // Default TL outputs
59	  io.tl.a.valid     := false.B
60	  io.tl.a.bits      := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelA(tlp))
61	  io.tl.d.ready     := false.B
62	
63	  switch(state) {
64	    is(sIdle) {
65	      // Prioritize writes
66	      when(io.axi.write.addr.valid && io.axi.write.data.valid) {
67	        io.axi.write.addr.ready := true.B
68	        io.axi.write.data.ready := true.B
69	        addrReg := io.axi.write.addr.bits.addr
70	        dataReg := io.axi.write.data.bits.data
71	        strbReg := io.axi.write.data.bits.strb
72	        sizeReg := io.axi.write.addr.bits.size
73	        idReg   := io.axi.write.addr.bits.id
74	        state   := sTlWr
75	      }.elsewhen(io.axi.read.addr.valid) {
76	        io.axi.read.addr.ready := true.B
77	        addrReg := io.axi.read.addr.bits.addr
78	        sizeReg := io.axi.read.addr.bits.size
79	        idReg   := io.axi.read.addr.bits.id
80	        state   := sTlRd
81	      }
82	    }
83	
84	    is(sTlWr) {
85	      io.tl.a.valid        := true.B
86	      io.tl.a.bits.opcode  := TLULOpcodesA.PutFullData
87	      io.tl.a.bits.param   := 0.U
88	      io.tl.a.bits.size    := sizeReg
89	      io.tl.a.bits.source  := idReg
90	      io.tl.a.bits.address := addrReg
91	      io.tl.a.bits.mask    := strbReg
92	      io.tl.a.bits.data    := dataReg
93	      io.tl.a.bits.corrupt := false.B
94	
95	      when(io.tl.a.ready) {
96	        state := sTlWrWait
97	      }
98	    }
99	
100	    is(sTlWrWait) {
101	      io.tl.d.ready := true.B
102	      when(io.tl.d.valid) {
103	        respReg := Mux(io.tl.d.bits.error, 2.U, 0.U)
104	        state   := sWrResp
105	      }
106	    }
107	
108	    is(sWrResp) {
109	      io.axi.write.resp.valid       := true.B
110	      io.axi.write.resp.bits.resp   := respReg
111	      io.axi.write.resp.bits.id     := idReg
112	      when(io.axi.write.resp.ready) {
113	        state := sIdle
114	      }
115	    }
116	
117	    is(sTlRd) {
118	      io.tl.a.valid        := true.B
119	      io.tl.a.bits.opcode  := TLULOpcodesA.Get
120	      io.tl.a.bits.param   := 0.U
121	      io.tl.a.bits.size    := sizeReg
122	      io.tl.a.bits.source  := idReg
123	      io.tl.a.bits.address := addrReg
124	      io.tl.a.bits.mask    := ((1.U << (1.U << sizeReg)) - 1.U)
125	      io.tl.a.bits.data    := 0.U
126	      io.tl.a.bits.corrupt := false.B
127	
128	      when(io.tl.a.ready) {
129	        state := sTlRdWait
130	      }
131	    }
132	
133	    is(sTlRdWait) {
134	      io.tl.d.ready := true.B
135	      when(io.tl.d.valid) {
136	        rdDataReg := io.tl.d.bits.data
137	        respReg   := Mux(io.tl.d.bits.error, 2.U, 0.U)
138	        state     := sRdData
139	      }
140	    }
141	
142	    is(sRdData) {
143	      io.axi.read.data.valid       := true.B
144	      io.axi.read.data.bits.data   := rdDataReg
145	      io.axi.read.data.bits.last   := true.B
146	      io.axi.read.data.bits.resp   := respReg
147	      io.axi.read.data.bits.id     := idReg
148	      when(io.axi.read.data.ready) {
149	        state := sIdle
150	      }
151	    }
152	  }
153	}

54	  // =========================================================================
55	  // Configuration registers
56	  // =========================================================================
57	  val ctrlReg   = RegInit(0.U(16.W))
58	  val csidReg   = RegInit(0.U(1.W))
59	  val csmodeReg = RegInit(0.U(1.W))
60	
61	  val spiEnable = ctrlReg(0)
62	  val cpol      = ctrlReg(1)
63	  val cpha      = ctrlReg(2)
64	  val hdrx      = ctrlReg(3)   // half-duplex RX
65	  val hdtx      = ctrlReg(4)   // half-duplex TX
66	  val divider   = ctrlReg(15, 8)  // baud rate divisor
67	
68	  // =========================================================================
69	  // TX and RX FIFOs (depth 4)
70	  // =========================================================================
71	  val TX_DEPTH = 4
72	  val RX_DEPTH = 4
73	
74	  val txFifo   = Module(new Queue(UInt(8.W), TX_DEPTH))
75	  val rxFifo   = Module(new Queue(UInt(8.W), RX_DEPTH))
76	
77	  // =========================================================================
78	  // SPI FSM
79	  // =========================================================================
80	  val spiIdle :: spiCS :: spiBit :: spiDone :: Nil = Enum(4)
81	  val spiState = RegInit(spiIdle)
82	
83	  val sclkReg    = RegInit(false.B)
84	  val mosiReg    = RegInit(false.B)
85	  val csbReg     = RegInit(true.B)
86	  val shiftReg   = RegInit(0.U(8.W))
87	  val rxShift    = RegInit(0.U(8.W))
88	  val bitCnt     = RegInit(0.U(4.W))  // 0..7
89	  val halfCnt    = RegInit(0.U(8.W))  // half-period counter
90	  val txByte     = RegInit(0.U(8.W))
91	  val spiHalfPeriod = WireDefault((divider +& 1.U)(7, 0))
92	
93	  // CS logic
94	  val manualCS  = csmodeReg === 1.U
95	  val autoCSActive = spiState =/= spiIdle && !manualCS
96	
97	  io.spi.sclk := sclkReg
98	  io.spi.mosi := mosiReg
99	  io.spi.csb  := Mux(manualCS, (csidReg === 0.U), !autoCSActive)
100	
101	  val txHasData  = txFifo.io.deq.valid
102	  val rxFull     = !rxFifo.io.enq.ready
103	  val rxEmpty    = !rxFifo.io.deq.valid
104	
105	  txFifo.io.enq.valid := false.B
106	  txFifo.io.enq.bits  := 0.U
107	  txFifo.io.deq.ready := false.B
108	
109	  rxFifo.io.enq.valid := false.B
110	  rxFifo.io.enq.bits  := 0.U
111	  rxFifo.io.deq.ready := false.B
112	
113	  // SPI is busy when in non-idle states
114	  val spiBusy = spiState =/= spiIdle
115	
116	  // Has TX data to send or in half-duplex RX mode (continuous clocking)
117	  val canStartTx = txHasData || hdrx
118	
119	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
120	  // SPI clock generation and bit shifting FSM
121	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
122	  switch(spiState) {
123	    is(spiIdle) {
124	      sclkReg := cpol  // idle polarity
125	      when(spiEnable && canStartTx && !rxFull) {
126	        when(txHasData) {
127	          txFifo.io.deq.ready := true.B
128	          shiftReg := txFifo.io.deq.bits
129	          txByte   := txFifo.io.deq.bits
130	        }.otherwise {
131	          shiftReg := 0.U
132	          txByte   := 0.U
133	        }
134	        rxShift  := 0.U
135	        bitCnt   := 0.U
136	        halfCnt  := 0.U
137	        spiState := spiBit
138	        // Drive MOSI with MSB immediately
139	        mosiReg := Mux(txHasData, txFifo.io.deq.bits(7), false.B)
140	      }
141	    }
142	
143	    is(spiBit) {
144	      // Increment half-period counter
145	      halfCnt := halfCnt + 1.U
146	      when(halfCnt >= spiHalfPeriod - 1.U) {
147	        halfCnt  := 0.U
148	        sclkReg  := !sclkReg
149	
150	        // On leading edge (CPOL=0: 0->1, CPOL=1: 1->0)
151	        val leadEdge = Mux(cpol, sclkReg, !sclkReg)  // sclkReg is about to toggle
152	        // On trailing edge
153	        val trailEdge = !leadEdge
154	
155	        // Sample MISO on the appropriate edge
156	        // Mode 0 (CPOL=0, CPHA=0): sample on rising (leading)
157	        // Mode 1 (CPOL=0, CPHA=1): sample on falling (trailing)
158	        // Mode 2 (CPOL=1, CPHA=0): sample on falling (leading)
159	        // Mode 3 (CPOL=1, CPHA=1): sample on rising (trailing)
160	        val sampleNow = Mux(cpha, trailEdge, leadEdge)
161	        val shiftNow  = !sampleNow  // shift MOSI on opposite edge
162	
163	        when(sampleNow) {
164	          // Shift in MISO MSB first
165	          rxShift := Cat(rxShift(6, 0), io.spi.miso)
166	        }
167	
168	        when(shiftNow) {
169	          // After sampling, shift out next bit
170	          val nextBit = Mux(bitCnt < 7.U, bitCnt + 1.U, bitCnt)
171	          mosiReg  := shiftReg(6.U - Mux(bitCnt < 7.U, bitCnt, 6.U))
172	        }
173	
174	        // Count half-periods: 16 half-periods = 8 full bits
175	        when(bitCnt === 15.U) {
176	          bitCnt   := 0.U
177	          spiState := spiDone
178	        }.otherwise {
179	          bitCnt := bitCnt + 1.U
180	        }
181	      }
182	    }
183	
184	    is(spiDone) {
185	      sclkReg := cpol
186	      // Store received byte if not in HDTX mode (TX-only half duplex)
187	      when(!hdtx) {
188	        when(rxFifo.io.enq.ready) {
189	          rxFifo.io.enq.valid := true.B
190	          rxFifo.io.enq.bits  := rxShift
191	          // Check if more data to send or in HDRX mode
192	          when(spiEnable && canStartTx && !rxFull) {
193	            when(txHasData) {
194	              txFifo.io.deq.ready := true.B
195	              shiftReg := txFifo.io.deq.bits
196	              txByte   := txFifo.io.deq.bits
197	              mosiReg  := txFifo.io.deq.bits(7)
198	            }.otherwise {
199	              shiftReg := 0.U
200	              txByte   := 0.U
201	              mosiReg  := false.B
202	            }
203	            rxShift  := 0.U
204	            bitCnt   := 0.U
205	            halfCnt  := 0.U
206	            spiState := spiBit
207	          }.otherwise {
208	            spiState := spiIdle
209	          }
210	        }.otherwise {
211	          // Stall: RX FIFO full, wait
212	        }
213	      }.otherwise {
214	        // HDTX: discard RX, continue
215	        when(spiEnable && canStartTx) {
216	          when(txHasData) {
217	            txFifo.io.deq.ready := true.B
218	            shiftReg := txFifo.io.deq.bits
219	            txByte   := txFifo.io.deq.bits
220	            mosiReg  := txFifo.io.deq.bits(7)
221	          }.otherwise {
222	            spiState := spiIdle
223	          }
224	          rxShift  := 0.U
225	          bitCnt   := 0.U
226	          halfCnt  := 0.U
227	          when(txHasData) {
228	            spiState := spiBit
229	          }
230	        }.otherwise {
231	          spiState := spiIdle
232	        }
233	      }
234	    }
235	  }
236	
237	  // =========================================================================
238	  // Status register
239	  // =========================================================================
240	  val statusReg = Cat(rxEmpty, spiBusy)
241	
242	  // =========================================================================
243	  // TL-UL CSR Slave
244	  // =========================================================================
245	  val sTLIdle :: sTLResp :: Nil = Enum(2)
246	  val tlState = RegInit(sTLIdle)
247	
248	  val tlRespData   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.dataBits.W))
249	  val tlRespError  = RegInit(false.B)
250	  val tlRespSource = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sourceBits.W))
251	  val tlRespSize   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sizeBits.W))
252	  val tlRespOpcode = RegInit(TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck)
253	
254	  io.tl.a.ready := false.B
255	  io.tl.d.valid := false.B
256	  io.tl.d.bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelD(tlp))
257	
258	  // Stall conditions: reading RXDATA when empty or writing TXDATA when full
259	  val txWriteStall = WireDefault(false.B)
260	  val rxReadStall  = WireDefault(false.B)
261	
262	  switch(tlState) {
263	    is(sTLIdle) {
264	      val addr    = io.tl.a.bits.address
265	      val isWrite = (io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutFullData) ||
266	                    (io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutPartialData)
267	      val isGet   = io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.Get
268	
269	      // Compute stall conditions combinationally
270	      when(io.tl.a.valid) {
271	        txWriteStall := isWrite && addr === 0x08.U && !txFifo.io.enq.ready
272	        rxReadStall  := isGet  && addr === 0x0c.U && rxEmpty
273	      }
274	
275	      // Accept if no stall
276	      io.tl.a.ready := io.tl.a.valid && !txWriteStall && !rxReadStall
277	
278	      when(io.tl.a.valid && !txWriteStall && !rxReadStall) {
279	        tlRespSource := io.tl.a.bits.source
280	        tlRespSize   := io.tl.a.bits.size
281	        tlRespError  := false.B
282	        tlRespData   := 0.U
283	
284	        when(isGet) {
285	          tlRespOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAckData
286	          when(addr === 0x00.U) {
287	            tlRespData := statusReg
288	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x04.U) {
289	            tlRespData := ctrlReg
290	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x0c.U) {
291	            // Pop from RX FIFO (ready was checked above, not empty)
292	            rxFifo.io.deq.ready := true.B
293	            tlRespData := rxFifo.io.deq.bits
294	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x10.U) {
295	            tlRespData := csidReg
296	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x14.U) {
297	            tlRespData := csmodeReg
298	          }.otherwise {
299	            tlRespData  := 0.U
300	            tlRespError := true.B
301	          }
302	        }.elsewhen(isWrite) {
303	          tlRespOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck
304	          when(addr === 0x00.U) {
305	            // STATUS is read-only
306	            tlRespError := true.B
307	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x04.U) {
308	            ctrlReg := io.tl.a.bits.data(15, 0)
309	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x08.U) {
310	            // Push to TX FIFO (space was checked above)
311	            txFifo.io.enq.valid := true.B
312	            txFifo.io.enq.bits  := io.tl.a.bits.data(7, 0)
313	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x10.U) {
314	            csidReg := io.tl.a.bits.data(0)
315	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x14.U) {
316	            csmodeReg := io.tl.a.bits.data(0)
317	          }.otherwise {
318	            tlRespError := true.B
319	          }
320	        }.otherwise {
321	          tlRespOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck
322	          tlRespError  := true.B
323	        }
324	
325	        tlState := sTLResp
326	      }
327	    }
328	
329	    is(sTLResp) {
330	      io.tl.d.valid        := true.B
331	      io.tl.d.bits.opcode  := tlRespOpcode
332	      io.tl.d.bits.param   := 0.U
333	      io.tl.d.bits.size    := tlRespSize
334	      io.tl.d.bits.source  := tlRespSource
335	      io.tl.d.bits.sink    := 0.U
336	      io.tl.d.bits.denied  := false.B
337	      io.tl.d.bits.data    := tlRespData
338	      io.tl.d.bits.corrupt := false.B
339	      io.tl.d.bits.error   := tlRespError
340	
341	      when(io.tl.d.ready) {
342	        tlState := sTLIdle
343	      }
344	    }
345	  }
346	}

22	/**
23	  * SPI-to-TileLink-UL bridge (version 2).
24	  *
25	  * SPI frame format (bytes, MSB-first per byte):
26	  *   Byte 0     : opcode  (0x01=read, 0x02=write)
27	  *   Bytes 1..4 : address (big-endian 32-bit)
28	  *   Bytes 5..6 : beats-1 (big-endian 16-bit)
29	  *   For write: Bytes 7..end : write data (beats * 16 bytes)
30	  *
31	  * Read response on MISO per beat: 0xFE sync byte + 16 data bytes
32	  * (little-endian: byte[i] = data[8i+7:8i]).
33	  */
34	class Spi2TLULV2(p: Parameters) extends Module {
35	  val tlp        = new TLULParameters(p)
36	  val BEAT_BYTES = tlp.dataBits / 8  // 16 bytes for 128-bit bus
37	
38	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
39	    val spi_clk   = Input(Clock())
40	    val spi_rst_n = Input(Bool())     // low = reset
41	
42	    val q_mosi_pin = Flipped(Decoupled(Bool()))
43	    val q_miso_pin = Decoupled(Bool())
44	
45	    val q_tl_a = Decoupled(new OpenTitanTileLink.A_Channel(tlp))
46	    val q_tl_d = Flipped(Decoupled(new OpenTitanTileLink.D_Channel(tlp)))
47	  })
48	
49	  class SpiReqDesc extends Bundle {
50	    val isWrite = Bool()
51	    val address = UInt(32.W)
52	    val wdata   = UInt(tlp.dataBits.W)
53	  }
54	
55	  val spiReset = !io.spi_rst_n
56	
57	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
58	  // Async queues for CDC
59	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
60	  val spiToSys = Module(new AsyncQueue(new SpiReqDesc, AsyncQueueParams(depth = 4, safe = false)))
61	  spiToSys.io.enq_clock := io.spi_clk
62	  spiToSys.io.enq_reset := spiReset
63	  spiToSys.io.deq_clock := clock
64	  spiToSys.io.deq_reset := reset.asBool
65	
66	  val sysToSpi = Module(new AsyncQueue(UInt(tlp.dataBits.W), AsyncQueueParams(depth = 4, safe = false)))
67	  sysToSpi.io.enq_clock := clock
68	  sysToSpi.io.enq_reset := reset.asBool
69	  sysToSpi.io.deq_clock := io.spi_clk
70	  sysToSpi.io.deq_reset := spiReset
71	
72	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
73	  // SPI clock domain sub-module
74	  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
75	
76	  /**
77	    * SpiDomain: all SPI-clocked logic inside a black-box Module so that
78	    * Chisel sees a clean clock/reset boundary.
79	    */
80	  class SpiDomain extends Module {
81	    val io = IO(new Bundle {
82	      // MOSI pin
83	      val mosi_valid = Input(Bool())
84	      val mosi_bits  = Input(Bool())
85	      val mosi_ready = Output(Bool())
86	
87	      // MISO pin
88	      val miso_valid = Output(Bool())
89	      val miso_bits  = Output(Bool())
90	      val miso_ready = Input(Bool())
91	
92	      // Enqueue to spiToSys
93	      val enq_valid = Output(Bool())
94	      val enq_ready = Input(Bool())
95	      val enq_bits  = Output(new SpiReqDesc)
96	
97	      // Dequeue from sysToSpi
98	      val deq_valid = Input(Bool())
99	      val deq_ready = Output(Bool())
100	      val deq_bits  = Input(UInt(tlp.dataBits.W))
101	    })
102	
103	    // Always accept MOSI
104	    io.mosi_ready := true.B
105	
106	    // Default outputs
107	    io.enq_valid := false.B
108	    io.enq_bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new SpiReqDesc)
109	    io.deq_ready := false.B
110	    io.miso_valid := false.B
111	    io.miso_bits  := false.B
112	
113	    // Bit accumulator
114	    val bitCnt = RegInit(0.U(4.W))
115	    val bitBuf = RegInit(0.U(8.W))
116	
117	    val byteRdy = WireDefault(false.B)
118	    val byteVal = WireDefault(0.U(8.W))
119	
120	    when(io.mosi_valid) {
121	      val newBuf = Cat(bitBuf(6, 0), io.mosi_bits.asUInt)
122	      bitBuf := newBuf
123	      bitCnt := bitCnt + 1.U
124	      when(bitCnt === 7.U) {
125	        bitCnt  := 0.U
126	        byteRdy := true.B
127	        byteVal := Cat(bitBuf(6, 0), io.mosi_bits.asUInt)
128	      }
129	    }
130	
131	    // Header buffer
132	    val hdrBuf  = Reg(Vec(7, UInt(8.W)))
133	    val hdrCnt  = RegInit(0.U(4.W))
134	    val inHdr   = RegInit(true.B)
135	
136	    // Payload
137	    val payBuf  = Reg(Vec(BEAT_BYTES, UInt(8.W)))
138	    val payCnt  = RegInit(0.U(5.W))
139	
140	    val isWriteReg  = RegInit(false.B)
141	    val addrReg     = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
142	    val numBeatsReg = RegInit(0.U(16.W))
143	    val beatIdx     = RegInit(0.U(16.W))
144	
145	    val rdPending = RegInit(false.B)
146	    val rdBeatIdx = RegInit(0.U(16.W))
147	
148	    // Byte processing
149	    when(byteRdy) {
150	      when(inHdr) {
151	        hdrBuf(hdrCnt) := byteVal
152	        hdrCnt := hdrCnt + 1.U
153	        when(hdrCnt === 6.U) {
154	          hdrCnt := 0.U
155	          val op    = hdrBuf(0)
156	          val addr  = Cat(hdrBuf(1), hdrBuf(2), hdrBuf(3), hdrBuf(4))
157	          val lf    = Cat(hdrBuf(5), byteVal)
158	          isWriteReg  := op === 0x02.U
159	          addrReg     := addr
160	          numBeatsReg := lf +& 1.U
161	          beatIdx     := 0.U
162	          payCnt      := 0.U
163	          when(op === 0x02.U) {
164	            inHdr := false.B
165	          }.otherwise {
166	            rdPending := true.B
167	            rdBeatIdx := 0.U
168	          }
169	        }
170	      }.otherwise {
171	        payBuf(payCnt) := byteVal
172	        payCnt := payCnt + 1.U
173	        when(payCnt === (BEAT_BYTES - 1).U) {
174	          payCnt := 0.U
175	          val wdata = Cat(
176	            byteVal,
177	            payBuf(14), payBuf(13), payBuf(12), payBuf(11),
178	            payBuf(10), payBuf(9),  payBuf(8),  payBuf(7),
179	            payBuf(6),  payBuf(5),  payBuf(4),  payBuf(3),
180	            payBuf(2),  payBuf(1),  payBuf(0)
181	          )
182	          val req = Wire(new SpiReqDesc)
183	          req.isWrite := true.B
184	          req.address := addrReg + (beatIdx << log2Ceil(BEAT_BYTES).U)
185	          req.wdata   := wdata
186	          io.enq_valid := true.B
187	          io.enq_bits  := req
188	
189	          beatIdx := beatIdx + 1.U
190	          when(beatIdx >= numBeatsReg - 1.U) {
191	            inHdr := true.B
192	          }
193	        }
194	      }
195	    }
196	
197	    // Dispatch read requests (only when not processing a byte this cycle)
198	    when(rdPending && !byteRdy) {
199	      val req = Wire(new SpiReqDesc)
200	      req.isWrite := false.B
201	      req.address := addrReg + (rdBeatIdx << log2Ceil(BEAT_BYTES).U)
202	      req.wdata   := 0.U
203	      when(io.enq_ready && !io.enq_valid) {
204	        io.enq_valid := true.B
205	        io.enq_bits  := req
206	        rdBeatIdx := rdBeatIdx + 1.U
207	        when(rdBeatIdx >= numBeatsReg - 1.U) {
208	          rdPending := false.B
209	        }
210	      }
211	    }
212	
213	    // MISO output FSM
214	    val msIdle :: msSync :: msData :: Nil = Enum(3)
215	    val misoState   = RegInit(msIdle)
216	    val misoData    = RegInit(0.U(tlp.dataBits.W))
217	    val misoByteCnt = RegInit(0.U(5.W))
218	    val misoBitCnt  = RegInit(0.U(4.W))
219	
220	    switch(misoState) {
221	      is(msIdle) {
222	        io.deq_ready := true.B
223	        when(io.deq_valid) {
224	          misoData    := io.deq_bits
225	          misoBitCnt  := 7.U
226	          misoByteCnt := 0.U
227	          misoState   := msSync
228	        }
229	      }
230	      is(msSync) {
231	        io.miso_valid := true.B
232	        io.miso_bits  := 0xfe.U(8.W)(misoBitCnt)
233	        when(io.miso_ready) {
234	          when(misoBitCnt === 0.U) {
235	            misoBitCnt  := 7.U
236	            misoByteCnt := 0.U
237	            misoState   := msData
238	          }.otherwise {
239	            misoBitCnt := misoBitCnt - 1.U
240	          }
241	        }
242	      }
243	      is(msData) {
244	        val curByte = (misoData >> (misoByteCnt << 3.U))(7, 0)
245	        io.miso_valid := true.B
246	        io.miso_bits  := curByte(misoBitCnt)
247	        when(io.miso_ready) {
248	          when(misoBitCnt === 0.U) {
249	            misoBitCnt := 7.U
250	            when(misoByteCnt === (BEAT_BYTES - 1).U) {
251	              misoByteCnt := 0.U
252	              misoState   := msIdle
253	            }.otherwise {
254	              misoByteCnt := misoByteCnt + 1.U
255	            }
256	          }.otherwise {
257	            misoBitCnt := misoBitCnt - 1.U
258	          }
259	        }

24	/**
25	  * SECDED (Single Error Correction, Double Error Detection) encoder.
26	  *
27	  * Computes ECC parity bits for a data word of arbitrary width.
28	  * The ECC uses a Hamming-based code with an extra overall parity bit.
29	  *
30	  * The number of parity bits required is ceil(log2(dataBits + numParityBits + 1)).
31	  * For 128-bit data, 8 parity bits are needed (7 Hamming + 1 overall).
32	  *
33	  * @param dataBits Width of the data word to protect.
34	  */
35	class SecdedEncoder(dataBits: Int) extends Module {
36	  // Number of Hamming parity bits needed
37	  val parBits = {
38	    var p = 1
39	    while ((1 << p) < dataBits + p + 1) p += 1
40	    p
41	  }
42	  val totalBits = dataBits + parBits + 1  // +1 for overall parity
43	
44	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
45	    val data_i = Input(UInt(dataBits.W))
46	    val ecc_o  = Output(UInt(7.W))  // always 7 bits output (padded if fewer needed)
47	  })
48	
49	  // Build the codeword: insert parity bits at power-of-2 positions
50	  // data bits occupy all non-power-of-2 positions (excluding position 0)
51	  val codeword = Wire(Vec(totalBits, Bool()))
52	  for (i <- 0 until totalBits) codeword(i) := false.B
53	
54	  // Place data bits
55	  var dataIdx = 0
56	  for (pos <- 1 until totalBits) {
57	    // pos is 1-based; check if it's a power of 2
58	    val isPowerOf2 = (pos & (pos - 1)) == 0
59	    if (!isPowerOf2) {
60	      if (dataIdx < dataBits) {
61	        codeword(pos - 1) := io.data_i(dataIdx)
62	        dataIdx += 1
63	      }
64	    }
65	  }
66	
67	  // Compute Hamming parity bits (each covers positions where bit j of pos is 1)
68	  val hammingPar = Wire(Vec(parBits, Bool()))
69	  for (j <- 0 until parBits) {
70	    val coveredBits = (1 until totalBits - 1).filter { pos =>
71	      (pos & (1 << j)) != 0 && (pos & (pos - 1)) != 0  // non-parity positions
72	    }.map(pos => if (pos - 1 < totalBits) codeword(pos - 1) else false.B)
73	    hammingPar(j) := coveredBits.foldLeft(false.B)(_ ^ _)
74	  }
75	
76	  // Overall parity
77	  val allBits = Wire(Vec(parBits + dataBits, Bool()))
78	  for (j <- 0 until parBits) allBits(j) := hammingPar(j)
79	  for (i <- 0 until dataBits) allBits(parBits + i) := io.data_i(i)
80	  val overallPar = allBits.reduce(_ ^ _)
81	
82	  // Pack ECC: [overall_par, hamming_par[parBits-1:0]]
83	  val eccBits = Wire(Vec(parBits + 1, Bool()))
84	  for (j <- 0 until parBits) eccBits(j) := hammingPar(j)
85	  eccBits(parBits) := overallPar
86	
87	  // Output as 7-bit field (zero-padded if parBits+1 < 7)
88	  // Concatenate up to 7 bits from eccBits
89	  val eccBitsAll = (0 until 7).map { j =>
90	    if (j <= parBits) eccBits(j).asUInt else 0.U(1.W)
91	  }
92	  io.ecc_o := Cat(eccBitsAll.reverse)
93	}

21	/**
22	  * TileLink-UL 1-to-N socket (address-based demultiplexer).
23	  *
24	  * Routes requests from a single host to one of N devices based on address ranges.
25	  * This 128-bit variant has a fixed configuration with 4 downstream ports and
26	  * standard 32-bit address ranges.
27	  */
28	class TlulSocket1N(p: Parameters, nDevices: Int, addrBase: Seq[Long], addrMask: Seq[Long]) extends Module {
29	  require(nDevices == addrBase.length && nDevices == addrMask.length)
30	  val tlp = new TLULParameters(p)
31	
32	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
33	    val host   = Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp))
34	    val device = Vec(nDevices, new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp))
35	  })
36	
37	  // State
38	  val sIdle :: sWaitD :: Nil = Enum(2)
39	  val state  = RegInit(sIdle)
40	  val selReg = RegInit(0.U(log2Ceil(nDevices).W))
41	
42	  // Default
43	  for (i <- 0 until nDevices) {
44	    io.device(i).a.valid := false.B
45	    io.device(i).a.bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelA(tlp))
46	    io.device(i).d.ready := false.B
47	  }
48	  io.host.a.ready := false.B
49	  io.host.d.valid := false.B
50	  io.host.d.bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelD(tlp))
51	
52	  // Address decode
53	  val sel = Wire(UInt(log2Ceil(nDevices).W))
54	  sel := 0.U
55	  for (i <- 0 until nDevices) {
56	    when((io.host.a.bits.address & addrMask(i).U) === addrBase(i).U) {
57	      sel := i.U
58	    }
59	  }
60	
61	  switch(state) {
62	    is(sIdle) {
63	      io.host.a.ready := io.device(sel).a.ready
64	      for (i <- 0 until nDevices) {
65	        io.device(i).a.valid := io.host.a.valid && (sel === i.U)
66	        io.device(i).a.bits  := io.host.a.bits
67	      }
68	      when(io.host.a.valid && io.device(sel).a.ready) {
69	        selReg := sel
70	        state  := sWaitD
71	      }
72	    }
73	    is(sWaitD) {
74	      io.device(selReg).d.ready := io.host.d.ready
75	      io.host.d.valid           := io.device(selReg).d.valid
76	      io.host.d.bits            := io.device(selReg).d.bits
77	      when(io.host.d.valid && io.host.d.ready) {
78	        state := sIdle
79	      }
80	    }
81	  }
82	}

123	    for (i <- 0 until N_DEVICES) {

21	/**
22	  * TileLink-UL M-to-1 socket (arbitrated multiplexer).
23	  *
24	  * Accepts requests from M hosts and forwards them to a single device,
25	  * using round-robin arbitration. Responses are routed back to the
26	  * originating host based on the source ID tag.
27	  */
28	class TlulSocketM1(p: Parameters, nHosts: Int) extends Module {
29	  val tlp = new TLULParameters(p)
30	
31	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
32	    val host   = Vec(nHosts, Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp)))
33	    val device = new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp)
34	  })
35	
36	  val arbiter = Module(new RRArbiter(new TLULChannelA(tlp), nHosts))
37	
38	  for (i <- 0 until nHosts) {
39	    arbiter.io.in(i).valid := io.host(i).a.valid
40	    arbiter.io.in(i).bits  := io.host(i).a.bits
41	    io.host(i).a.ready     := arbiter.io.in(i).ready
42	  }
43	
44	  // Tag the source with host index (encode in upper bits of source)
45	  val taggedA  = Wire(new TLULChannelA(tlp))
46	  taggedA      := arbiter.io.out.bits
47	  taggedA.source := Cat(arbiter.io.chosen, arbiter.io.out.bits.source(tlp.sourceBits - log2Ceil(nHosts) - 2, 0))
48	
49	  io.device.a.valid := arbiter.io.out.valid
50	  io.device.a.bits  := taggedA
51	  arbiter.io.out.ready := io.device.a.ready
52	
53	  // Route D channel back to the correct host
54	  val hostSel = io.device.d.bits.source(tlp.sourceBits - 1, tlp.sourceBits - log2Ceil(nHosts))
55	  for (i <- 0 until nHosts) {
56	    io.host(i).d.valid := io.device.d.valid && (hostSel === i.U)
57	    io.host(i).d.bits  := io.device.d.bits
58	  }
59	  io.device.d.ready := MuxLookup(hostSel, false.B)(
60	    (0 until nHosts).map(i => i.U -> io.host(i).d.ready)
61	  )
62	}

21	/**
22	  * TileLink-UL width conversion bridge.
23	  *
24	  * Converts between two TL-UL buses of different data widths.
25	  * The narrow side is the host (requestor) and the wide side is the device.
26	  *
27	  * This implementation handles the common case of 2:1 width ratio by
28	  * splitting wide writes and merging narrow reads.
29	  *
30	  * @param narrowP Parameters for the narrow (host) side
31	  * @param wideP   Parameters for the wide (device) side
32	  */
33	class TlulWidthBridge(narrowP: Parameters, wideP: Parameters) extends Module {
34	  val narrowTlp = new TLULParameters(narrowP)
35	  val wideTlp   = new TLULParameters(wideP)
36	
37	  require(wideTlp.dataBits >= narrowTlp.dataBits, "Wide bus must be >= narrow bus")
38	  val ratio = wideTlp.dataBits / narrowTlp.dataBits
39	
40	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
41	    val narrow = Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(narrowTlp))  // host side
42	    val wide   = new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(wideTlp)              // device side
43	  })
44	
45	  if (ratio == 1) {
46	    // Pass-through with type conversion
47	    io.wide.a.valid          := io.narrow.a.valid
48	    io.wide.a.bits.opcode    := io.narrow.a.bits.opcode
49	    io.wide.a.bits.param     := io.narrow.a.bits.param
50	    io.wide.a.bits.size      := io.narrow.a.bits.size
51	    io.wide.a.bits.source    := io.narrow.a.bits.source
52	    io.wide.a.bits.address   := io.narrow.a.bits.address
53	    io.wide.a.bits.mask      := io.narrow.a.bits.mask
54	    io.wide.a.bits.data      := io.narrow.a.bits.data
55	    io.wide.a.bits.corrupt   := io.narrow.a.bits.corrupt
56	    io.narrow.a.ready        := io.wide.a.ready
57	
58	    io.narrow.d.valid        := io.wide.d.valid
59	    io.narrow.d.bits.opcode  := io.wide.d.bits.opcode
60	    io.narrow.d.bits.param   := io.wide.d.bits.param
61	    io.narrow.d.bits.size    := io.wide.d.bits.size
62	    io.narrow.d.bits.source  := io.wide.d.bits.source
63	    io.narrow.d.bits.sink    := io.wide.d.bits.sink
64	    io.narrow.d.bits.denied  := io.wide.d.bits.denied
65	    io.narrow.d.bits.data    := io.wide.d.bits.data(narrowTlp.dataBits - 1, 0)
66	    io.narrow.d.bits.corrupt := io.wide.d.bits.corrupt
67	    io.narrow.d.bits.error   := io.wide.d.bits.error
68	    io.wide.d.ready          := io.narrow.d.ready
69	  } else {
70	    // Simple width extension: zero-extend data and mask
71	    io.wide.a.valid          := io.narrow.a.valid
72	    io.wide.a.bits.opcode    := io.narrow.a.bits.opcode
73	    io.wide.a.bits.param     := io.narrow.a.bits.param
74	    io.wide.a.bits.size      := io.narrow.a.bits.size
75	    io.wide.a.bits.source    := io.narrow.a.bits.source
76	    io.wide.a.bits.address   := io.narrow.a.bits.address
77	    io.wide.a.bits.mask      := io.narrow.a.bits.mask.pad(wideTlp.dataBits / 8)
78	    io.wide.a.bits.data      := io.narrow.a.bits.data.pad(wideTlp.dataBits)
79	    io.wide.a.bits.corrupt   := io.narrow.a.bits.corrupt
80	    io.narrow.a.ready        := io.wide.a.ready
81	
82	    io.narrow.d.valid        := io.wide.d.valid
83	    io.narrow.d.bits.opcode  := io.wide.d.bits.opcode
84	    io.narrow.d.bits.param   := io.wide.d.bits.param
85	    io.narrow.d.bits.size    := io.wide.d.bits.size
86	    io.narrow.d.bits.source  := io.wide.d.bits.source
87	    io.narrow.d.bits.sink    := io.wide.d.bits.sink
88	    io.narrow.d.bits.denied  := io.wide.d.bits.denied
89	    io.narrow.d.bits.data    := io.wide.d.bits.data(narrowTlp.dataBits - 1, 0)

21	/**
22	  * TileLink-UL ID remapper.
23	  *
24	  * Remaps source IDs from a large host-side ID space to a smaller device-side
25	  * ID space. Maintains a table mapping allocated device IDs back to original
26	  * host source IDs.
27	  *
28	  * @param p          Parameters for the data bus
29	  * @param nEntries   Number of in-flight transactions supported
30	  */
31	class TlulIdRemapper(p: Parameters, nEntries: Int = 8) extends Module {
32	  val hostTlp   = new TLULParameters(p)
33	
34	  // Device-side uses fewer source bits
35	  val devSourceBits = log2Ceil(nEntries)
36	
37	  class DevTLULParams extends TLULParameters(p) {
38	    override val sourceBits: Int = devSourceBits
39	  }
40	  val devTlp = new DevTLULParams
41	
42	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
43	    val host   = Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(hostTlp))
44	    val device = new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(devTlp)
45	  })
46	
47	  // ID mapping table: device_id → original host source
48	  val srcTable  = Reg(Vec(nEntries, UInt(hostTlp.sourceBits.W)))
49	  val validVec  = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(nEntries)(false.B)))
50	
51	  // Find a free entry
52	  val freeEntry = PriorityEncoder(validVec.map(!_))
53	  val hasFree   = validVec.map(!_).reduce(_ || _)
54	
55	  // A channel
56	  io.host.a.ready        := hasFree && io.device.a.ready
57	  io.device.a.valid      := io.host.a.valid && hasFree
58	  io.device.a.bits       := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelA(devTlp))
59	  io.device.a.bits.opcode  := io.host.a.bits.opcode
60	  io.device.a.bits.param   := io.host.a.bits.param
61	  io.device.a.bits.size    := io.host.a.bits.size
62	  io.device.a.bits.source  := freeEntry
63	  io.device.a.bits.address := io.host.a.bits.address
64	  io.device.a.bits.mask    := io.host.a.bits.mask
65	  io.device.a.bits.data    := io.host.a.bits.data

80	  io.host.d.bits.param   := io.device.d.bits.param

21	/**
22	  * Core-Level Interrupt Controller (CLINT).
23	  *
24	  * Generates machine software (msip) and machine timer (mtip) interrupts.
25	  * Compatible with the RISC-V CLINT specification.
26	  *
27	  * Register map (byte addresses):
28	  *   0x0000 : msip      (r/w, 32-bit) - machine software interrupt pending
29	  *   0x4000 : mtimecmp  (r/w, 64-bit) - timer compare register
30	  *   0xbff8 : mtime     (r/w, 64-bit) - machine timer
31	  */
32	class Clint(p: Parameters) extends Module {
33	  val tlp = new TLULParameters(p)
34	
35	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
36	    val tl   = Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp))
37	    val msip = Output(Bool())
38	    val mtip = Output(Bool())
39	  })
40	
41	  // CLINT registers
42	  val msipReg     = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
43	  val mtimecmpReg = RegInit(((BigInt(1) << 64) - 1).U(64.W))  // max value = no interrupt
44	  val mtimeReg    = RegInit(0.U(64.W))
45	
46	  // Timer increment every cycle
47	  mtimeReg := mtimeReg + 1.U
48	
49	  // Interrupts
50	  io.msip := msipReg(0)
51	  io.mtip := mtimeReg >= mtimecmpReg
52	
53	  // TL-UL slave state machine
54	  val sIdle :: sResp :: Nil = Enum(2)
55	  val state = RegInit(sIdle)
56	
57	  val respData   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.dataBits.W))
58	  val respError  = RegInit(false.B)
59	  val respSource = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sourceBits.W))
60	  val respSize   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sizeBits.W))
61	  val respOpcode = RegInit(TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck)
62	
63	  io.tl.a.ready := false.B
64	  io.tl.d.valid := false.B
65	  io.tl.d.bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelD(tlp))
66	
67	  switch(state) {
68	    is(sIdle) {
69	      io.tl.a.ready := true.B
70	      when(io.tl.a.valid) {
71	        val addr    = io.tl.a.bits.address
72	        val isWrite = (io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutFullData) ||
73	                      (io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutPartialData)
74	        val isGet   = io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.Get
75	
76	        respSource := io.tl.a.bits.source
77	        respSize   := io.tl.a.bits.size
78	        respError  := false.B
79	        respData   := 0.U
80	
81	        when(isGet) {
82	          respOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAckData
83	          when(addr === 0x0000.U) {
84	            respData := msipReg
85	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x4000.U) {
86	            respData := mtimecmpReg(tlp.dataBits - 1, 0)
87	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0xbff8.U) {
88	            respData := mtimeReg(tlp.dataBits - 1, 0)
89	          }.otherwise {
90	            respError := true.B
91	          }
92	        }.elsewhen(isWrite) {
93	          respOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck
94	          when(addr === 0x0000.U) {
95	            msipReg := io.tl.a.bits.data(31, 0)
96	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x4000.U) {
97	            mtimecmpReg := io.tl.a.bits.data(63.min(tlp.dataBits - 1), 0)
98	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0xbff8.U) {
99	            mtimeReg := io.tl.a.bits.data(63.min(tlp.dataBits - 1), 0)
100	          }.otherwise {
101	            respError := true.B
102	          }
103	        }.otherwise {
104	          respOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck
105	          respError  := true.B
106	        }
107	
108	        state := sResp
109	      }
110	    }
111	
112	    is(sResp) {
113	      io.tl.d.valid        := true.B
114	      io.tl.d.bits.opcode  := respOpcode
115	      io.tl.d.bits.param   := 0.U
116	      io.tl.d.bits.size    := respSize
117	      io.tl.d.bits.source  := respSource
118	      io.tl.d.bits.sink    := 0.U
119	      io.tl.d.bits.denied  := false.B
120	      io.tl.d.bits.data    := respData
121	      io.tl.d.bits.corrupt := false.B
122	      io.tl.d.bits.error   := respError
123	
124	      when(io.tl.d.ready) {
125	        state := sIdle
126	      }
127	    }
128	  }
129	}

21	/**
22	  * Platform-Level Interrupt Controller (PLIC).
23	  *
24	  * Manages interrupt sources and arbitrates to produce an external interrupt
25	  * pending (eip) signal for a single hart.
26	  *
27	  * Register map:
28	  *   0x0000..0x0ffc : Priority registers (one per source, 32-bit)
29	  *   0x1000..0x107c : Interrupt pending bits (32 sources per word)
30	  *   0x2000..0x20fc : Interrupt enable bits (32 sources per word)
31	  *   0x200000       : Priority threshold
32	  *   0x200004       : Claim/complete register
33	  *
34	  * @param p        coralnpu Parameters
35	  * @param nSources Number of interrupt sources (default 32)
36	  */
37	class Plic(p: Parameters, nSources: Int = 32) extends Module {
38	  val tlp = new TLULParameters(p)
39	
40	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
41	    val tl  = Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp))
42	    val irq = Input(Vec(nSources, Bool()))
43	    val eip = Output(Bool())
44	  })
45	
46	  // Registers
47	  val priorityReg   = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(nSources)(0.U(32.W))))
48	  val enableReg     = RegInit(0.U(nSources.W))
49	  val thresholdReg  = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
50	  val pendingReg    = RegInit(0.U(nSources.W))
51	  val claimedReg    = RegInit(0.U(nSources.W))
52	
53	  // Update pending: set on irq edge, clear on claim
54	  val irqVec = Cat(io.irq.reverse)
55	  pendingReg := (pendingReg | irqVec) & ~claimedReg
56	  claimedReg := 0.U  // auto-clear
57	
58	  // EIP: any enabled pending interrupt with priority > threshold
59	  val activeBits = Wire(Vec(nSources, Bool()))
60	  for (i <- 0 until nSources) {
61	    activeBits(i) := pendingReg(i) && enableReg(i) && (priorityReg(i) > thresholdReg)
62	  }
63	  io.eip := activeBits.reduce(_ || _)
64	
65	  // TL-UL slave
66	  val sIdle :: sResp :: Nil = Enum(2)
67	  val state = RegInit(sIdle)
68	
69	  val respData   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.dataBits.W))
70	  val respError  = RegInit(false.B)
71	  val respSource = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sourceBits.W))
72	  val respSize   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sizeBits.W))
73	  val respOpcode = RegInit(TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck)
74	
75	  io.tl.a.ready := false.B
76	  io.tl.d.valid := false.B
77	  io.tl.d.bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelD(tlp))
78	
79	  switch(state) {
80	    is(sIdle) {
81	      io.tl.a.ready := true.B
82	      when(io.tl.a.valid) {
83	        val addr    = io.tl.a.bits.address
84	        val isWrite = (io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutFullData) ||
85	                      (io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutPartialData)
86	        val isGet   = io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.Get
87	
88	        respSource := io.tl.a.bits.source
89	        respSize   := io.tl.a.bits.size
90	        respError  := false.B
91	        respData   := 0.U
92	
93	        // Priority register range: 0x0000..0x0ffc
94	        val inPriority = addr < (nSources * 4).U
95	        val prioIdx    = addr(log2Ceil(nSources) + 1, 2)
96	
97	        // Pending bits: 0x1000
98	        val inPending  = addr === 0x1000.U
99	
100	        // Enable bits: 0x2000
101	        val inEnable   = addr === 0x2000.U
102	
103	        // Threshold: 0x200000
104	        val inThreshold = addr === 0x200000.U
105	
106	        // Claim/complete: 0x200004
107	        val inClaim    = addr === 0x200004.U
108	
109	        when(isGet) {
110	          respOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAckData
111	          when(inPriority) {
112	            respData := priorityReg(prioIdx)
113	          }.elsewhen(inPending) {
114	            respData := pendingReg
115	          }.elsewhen(inEnable) {
116	            respData := enableReg
117	          }.elsewhen(inThreshold) {
118	            respData := thresholdReg
119	          }.elsewhen(inClaim) {
120	            // Find highest-priority pending+enabled interrupt
121	            val claimId = Wire(UInt(log2Ceil(nSources + 1).W))
122	            claimId := 0.U
123	            for (i <- nSources - 1 to 0 by -1) {
124	              when(activeBits(i)) { claimId := (i + 1).U }
125	            }
126	            respData := claimId
127	            when(claimId > 0.U) {
128	              claimedReg := 1.U << (claimId - 1.U)
129	            }
130	          }.otherwise {
131	            respError := true.B
132	          }
133	        }.elsewhen(isWrite) {
134	          respOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck
135	          when(inPriority) {
136	            priorityReg(prioIdx) := io.tl.a.bits.data(31, 0)
137	          }.elsewhen(inEnable) {
138	            enableReg := io.tl.a.bits.data(nSources - 1, 0)
139	          }.elsewhen(inThreshold) {
140	            thresholdReg := io.tl.a.bits.data(31, 0)
141	          }.elsewhen(inClaim) {
142	            // Complete: clear the pending bit for the completed interrupt
143	            val completeId = io.tl.a.bits.data(log2Ceil(nSources), 0)
144	            when(completeId > 0.U && completeId <= nSources.U) {
145	              pendingReg := pendingReg & ~(1.U << (completeId - 1.U))
146	            }
147	          }.otherwise {
148	            respError := true.B
149	          }
150	        }.otherwise {
151	          respOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck
152	          respError  := true.B
153	        }
154	
155	        state := sResp
156	      }
157	    }
158	
159	    is(sResp) {
160	      io.tl.d.valid        := true.B
161	      io.tl.d.bits.opcode  := respOpcode
162	      io.tl.d.bits.param   := 0.U
163	      io.tl.d.bits.size    := respSize
164	      io.tl.d.bits.source  := respSource
165	      io.tl.d.bits.sink    := 0.U
166	      io.tl.d.bits.denied  := false.B
167	      io.tl.d.bits.data    := respData
168	      io.tl.d.bits.corrupt := false.B
169	      io.tl.d.bits.error   := respError
170	
171	      when(io.tl.d.ready) {
172	        state := sIdle
173	      }
174	    }
175	  }
176	}

21	// Memory region descriptor (Scala compile-time only)
22	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

25	  val IMEM, DMEM, Peripheral = Value
26	}

28	/** Describes a contiguous address range in the system memory map.
29	  *
30	  * @param base  Base address (inclusive)
31	  * @param size  Size in bytes
32	  * @param kind  Region type (IMEM / DMEM / Peripheral)
33	  */
34	class MemoryRegion(val base: Int, val size: Int, val kind: MemoryRegionType.Value) {

43	/** Source-side fabric port (as seen by the fabric / arbiter).
44	  *
45	  * From the DUT's perspective (the FabricArbiter or FabricMux):
46	  *   - readDataAddr / writeDataAddr / writeDataBits / writeDataStrb are INPUTS
47	  *     (the source drives them).
48	  *   - readData is an OUTPUT (the DUT drives data back to the source).
49	  */
50	class FabricSourcePort(dataBits: Int, addrBits: Int) extends Bundle {
51	  val readDataAddr  = Flipped(Valid(UInt(addrBits.W)))
52	  val writeDataAddr = Flipped(Valid(UInt(addrBits.W)))
53	  val writeDataBits = Input(UInt(dataBits.W))
54	  val writeDataStrb = Input(UInt(4.W))
55	  val readData      = Valid(UInt(dataBits.W))
56	}

58	/** Downstream fabric output port (as seen by the FabricArbiter / FabricMux).
59	  *
60	  * From the DUT's perspective:
61	  *   - readDataAddr / writeDataAddr / writeDataBits / writeDataStrb are OUTPUTS
62	  *     (the DUT drives them toward the downstream fabric).
63	  *   - readData is an INPUT (the downstream fabric drives data back).
64	  */
65	class FabricOutPort(dataBits: Int, addrBits: Int) extends Bundle {
66	  val readDataAddr  = Valid(UInt(addrBits.W))
67	  val writeDataAddr = Valid(UInt(addrBits.W))
68	  val writeDataBits = Output(UInt(dataBits.W))
69	  val writeDataStrb = Output(UInt(4.W))

78	  *
79	  * Arbitration policy: source(0) has highest priority. A source is "busy"
80	  * if any lower-indexed (higher-priority) source has an active request.
81	  *
82	  * The downstream readData response is broadcast to ALL sources simultaneously.
83	  */
84	class FabricArbiter(p: Parameters, n: Int = 2) extends Module {
85	  val addrBits = 32
86	  val dataBits = p.lsuDataBits

88	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
89	    val source     = Vec(n, new FabricSourcePort(dataBits, addrBits))
90	    val port       = new FabricOutPort(dataBits, addrBits)
91	    val fabricBusy = Output(Vec(n, Bool()))
92	  })
93	
94	  // fabricBusy(i) = OR of (any j < i has a valid request)
95	  for (i <- 0 until n) {
96	    val higherPriorityBusy = (0 until i).map { j =>
97	      io.source(j).readDataAddr.valid || io.source(j).writeDataAddr.valid
98	    }
99	    io.fabricBusy(i) := higherPriorityBusy.foldLeft(false.B)(_ || _)
100	  }

103	  val selectedRead  = Wire(Bool())
104	  val selectedWrite = Wire(Bool())
105	  val selectedAddr  = Wire(UInt(addrBits.W))
106	  val selectedWData = Wire(UInt(dataBits.W))
107	  val selectedWStrb = Wire(UInt(4.W))

110	  selectedWrite := false.B
111	  selectedAddr  := 0.U
112	  selectedWData := 0.U
113	  selectedWStrb := 0.U

118	  for (i <- (n - 1) to 0 by -1) {
119	    when (io.source(i).readDataAddr.valid) {
120	      selectedRead  := true.B
121	      selectedWrite := false.B
122	      selectedAddr  := io.source(i).readDataAddr.bits

125	      selectedWrite := true.B

134	  io.port.readDataAddr.bits   := selectedAddr
135	  io.port.writeDataAddr.valid := selectedWrite
136	  io.port.writeDataAddr.bits  := selectedAddr
137	  io.port.writeDataBits       := selectedWData
138	  io.port.writeDataStrb       := selectedWStrb

161	  val dataBits = p.lsuDataBits
162	  val n        = memoryRegions.length
163

165	    val source     = new FabricSourcePort(dataBits, addrBits)

169	  })

172	  for (j <- 0 until n) {
173	    io.ports(j).readDataAddr.valid  := false.B
174	    io.ports(j).readDataAddr.bits   := 0.U
175	    io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.valid := false.B
176	    io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.bits  := 0.U
177	    io.ports(j).writeDataBits       := io.source.writeDataBits
178	    io.ports(j).writeDataStrb       := io.source.writeDataStrb
179	  }
180	
181	  // Route read requests
182	  for (j <- 0 until n) {
183	    val region   = memoryRegions(j)
184	    val baseU    = region.base.U(addrBits.W)

117	  }.elsewhen (rdDataConsumed) {
